response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, sp.memusagegb, CASE WHEN sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu != 0 THEN CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / sp.proccpu ELSE NULL END as gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8), per_site_averages AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(memusagegb) as avg_ram, AVG(gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM filtered GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) as avg_of_site_avgs_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_of_site_avgs_gpu_cpu FROM per_site_averages GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat
